programmes.show_description: This Is CBeebies. Programmes start at 6.00am.
Orange. Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the daring tightrope-walking Orange!
Not Yours. Children's animation. Bing helps Flop do the shopping, but while Flop is paying, Bing finds a strawberry lolly that he can't resist putting in his pocket.
Washing. Preschool series. Po eats Tubby Custard and gets a messy bib. Po washes the bib and hangs it up to dry before eating more Tubby Custard with Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa.
Face Wipe. Preschool animation. When Tee gets involved in cake-making, he inevitably ends up with cake on his face. Mo is on hand with a face wipe, but Tee has other ideas.
Da Veggie Code. Supertato needs his Tato belt, but it's locked inside a glass case and he can't get it out.
Names. Pando has an earworm, and Bing isn't impressed.
Big Top Bo. Tao can't go on with his circus performance, so there are going to be some disappointed fans, unless Bo agrees to do all the acts for him - with some help from Mojo's tops!
Eugene's Animal Chorus. Join Squirrel Club to help Norrie count shells, to guess why Horse and Guinea Pig are the same, and to dance and sing along to Eugene's catchy animal sounds song!
The Training Badge. The Squirrels need some training to improve their concentration.
Surprise. Bluey and Bingo want Dad to play two different games, so Dad plays both at the same time.
Sleepytime. Bingo and Floppy have an intergalactic adventure in Bingo's dream, while the rest of her sleep-deprived family try to navigate Bingo's nonstop night-time bed-hopping.
Funky Fireflies, Selangor River, Malaysia. A trip to see fireflies becomes a rescue when Xuli and Glitch get stuck in a swamp.
The Tale of the Go-Kart Getaway. Animated series. Sammy Whiskers and Tommy Brock steal the rabbits' go-kart - with Cotton-tail on board!
The Great Algae Escape. Animated deep sea adventures with Captain Barnacles and his explorers. The crew must catch a runaway Octopod after it is hijacked by a group of crustaceans.
Eight. Children's animation. Numberland is rocked by the arrival of superblock Eight, known to his friends and fans as Octoblock.
Zap. The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. Z likes a good snooze, filling the air with floaty zeds.
Is It Healthy or Not? It's curry night, and Nick writes a song to help him remember to buy lots of healthy ingredients, but will he remember to buy Norman's dog treats?
Volcanic Rock. The family is walking down the track. The Nogglins have fun discovering some caves. But who is Yapp-Yapp talking to?
Towel. Bella plays funny games with Lift using her colourful towel. Together, they visit Hettie in the Ice Disco, who uses a big towel to make up a new dance - the Butterfly Boogie!
Fossil. Sula finds a beautiful fossil in the Howly Woods, so Bing wants to find one too.
Treasure. Dee encourages a friend to say 'treasure', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure! We see lots of treasure - gold treasure, sunken treasure and yummy treat treasure.
Tidy Time. Biba gets upset when her clay star goes missing while they're tidying up.
Camping Badges. The Piggies help Keith and Rebecca earn their camping badges.
More About Turning. Stop-motion preschool programme. The Twirlywoos visit a skate park and practise turning on a skateboard, and the Marching Band visits the Big Red Boat.
The Zoo. Justin and his friends visit a zoo, where they meet pandas, lemurs and elephants! Meanwhile, Tumble Cottage ends up full of animals when all the teddies have play dates.
Say Hello. Preschool series. Tinky Winky and Laa-Laa are in Home Dome when the Tubby Phone rings. It is Dipsy and Po calling from the Tubby Mobile to say hello.
Books. Nigel and Baby Bear encourage grown-ups and their babies to explore different books through discovery, play, song and a story. Everyone at home can join in too!
Wind Farm Beach. Elsee plays I-spy whilst on a beach walk with Mohamoud.

programmes.show_name: New: What's in Your Plant Pot?
programmes.show_description: Tomatoes. Heritage seed expert Lucy and the Fact Pack explore the colourful world of heritage tomatoes and discover why eating different-coloured fruits and vegetables is good for us.
Too Hot! A paper plate crab is the first make of the day, and an old wooden spoon becomes a spoon monster. The Recycling Express provides yogurt pots to make a palm tree.
King of the Glowy Things. Wasabi eats a rare glownut and attracts all the glowing creatures, who crown him king!
The Dump. On a trip to the dump, Dad claims he's the best at everything.
The Board Game Badge. It is a rainy day in the clubhouse, which means it's a perfect day for a board game.

programmes.show_name: Hey Duggee: Top of the Pups
programmes.show_description: Making Music. We're making music! Ha! Ha! We're making music!
Silly Faces and Picnic Walk. Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers explore a market and make silly faces on a walk to a picnic.
George and Freddie's Woodland Adventure. George and Freddie go on an intrepid woodland adventure. Look out for the troll!
Malika's Moroccan Fish Ball Tagine. Malika shows us how to make a Moroccan fish ball tagine. She uses fresh fish poached in spices and cooks it in a traditional Moroccan tagine.
Ice Rink and Bouncy Castle. Maddie finds out how an ice rink stays cold and discovers how bouncy castles are made.
Mission: Pet Shop. Hearing dog Diesel is on a mission to get some dog food and a new toy from the pet shop.
Meerkat and Giant Millipede. Steve and Aneeshwar meet some busy meerkats and huge giant millipedes.
Waffle's Visit. Preschool comedy drama series. The Brooklyn-Bells take Waffle to Mrs Hobbs' house, hoping to show her how well behaved he has become.
Flooded Burrow. The puffin burrow floods, so Oona and Baba stay with May until it dries out.
Art. Animated series about a group of singing potatoes. In this blues song, the Potatoes enter famous paintings and sculptures, celebrating different ways art is created.
Jumbled Up. When Yukee is asked to carry several messages across the garden to Sonny, she comes up with a clever rhyming song to help her remember them all.
Knock Knock. Maddie and Triggs sing about all the things they love regarding their favourite travelling Uncle George as they wait, and wait, and wait for his latest letter to arrive.
The A Cappella Badge. The Squirrels are inspired to learn how to sing a cappella style after hearing a famous bird quartet singing in a nearby tree.
Five's Super Sorter. Numberblocks Five and Two are in their toy library, but all their favourite toys are jumbled up. Can their new friend Sorty the Super Sorter help sort out their problem?
Ned. Alphablock E searches for a home for Ned the frog. They have no luck with a BED, a DEN or a PEN, which belongs to a cross HEN. Then, a VET suggests somewhere WET. Ned loves his pond!
Treasure Hunt. Justin and his friends go on a treasure hunt, and Mr Tumble's cake goes on an adventure!
Toast. Preschool series. The Teletubbies eat lots of tubby toast and make a huge pile of crumbs. Luckily, the Noo-noo is on hand to clean up.
Puddles. Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers go on an eco quest to find out all about puddles.
Loop, Swoop and Pull. Elvis must learn to tie his own laces quickly to achieve his PB in goalkeeping.
Building Machines. CBeebies' motorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing machines that all help to build.
Andrewsarchus and Tooth. Preschool adventure series. Andy travels back 36 million years in time to find a tooth belonging to a giant carnivorous predator.
Wild Meadow. Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers go on a mini quest to make their own wild meadows.
Antarctica Rescue. Paani and a skua are swept away by melting ice. Dashi and Natquik rush to save them!
The Tale of the Squeaky Toy. Animated series. When Peter loses Cotton-tail's beloved squeaky rabbit toy, he must run the gauntlet of his enemies to get it back!
The Comic Badge. Duggee is reading the Squirrels one of his favourite comics. They are eager to know the ending, but the comic was discontinued!
Koa Nails It. Koa's nails are long and sharp, but he's afraid to cut them. Vida knows just how to make it fun - nail polish!
Evil Peamobile Goes Rogue. Evil Pea adds a voice control feature to her Evil Peamobile, but when she calls it a nitwit, the car decides to teach her a lesson.
Mission Bling-Bling. Weasy falls in love with a gold watch, but it belongs to the farmer...
Cheesy Bang Bang. The cheese delivery race is on as Mojo and the racer top try to deliver food faster than Filo. But the competition gets too hot when an explosive souffle is on the table!
Surprise. Bluey and Bingo want Dad to play two different games, so Dad plays both at the same time.
The Piri Fitness Craze. Nugget's new fitness device sparks a craze on the berg. Running, skating and jumping, the Piris battle it out to score the most points, with a surprise winner.
Sleepytime. Bingo and Floppy have an intergalactic adventure in Bingo's dream, while the rest of her sleep-deprived family try to navigate Bingo's nonstop night-time bed-hopping.
Andy Goes Fishing on Dino Island. Andy goes fishing on Dino Island to see what new prehistoric fish he can discover.
Night Night, Waffle. Preschool comedy drama series. The family spend their first night together, but they and their neighbours are kept awake by Waffle's constant barking.
The Basketball Wish. Rafi's magic basketball makes every basket, but she discovers that real victory is earned, and scoring only feels special when you've worked for it.
It's Time to Open a Cafe. After visiting the park cafe, JoJo and Gran Gran decide to make their own play cafe.
Whatsathingy. Animation for preschool children. Sarah and Duck try to work out exactly what it is that Scarf Lady has been busily knitting in her sleep.
The Tin Bird. Animation about a family of small creatures who live on, and inside, a planet. A tin bird lands on the Clangers' planet. Tiny and Small think it wants to build a nest.
Baby Tweety. MeMo and BaBa look after Baby Tweety on a play date. They have lots of fun playing hide-and-seek and giving Baby Tweety some food. Looking after little ones can be tiring.
Upsy Daisy's Tiring Walk. Igglepiggle and Upsy Daisy go on a long walk. Feeling tired, they decide to return by Ninky Nonk - and have a very bouncy ride.
Sir Lewis Hamilton - Small's Big Dream. Sir Lewis Hamilton reads an inspiring Bedtime Story about daring to dream big.
This Is CBeebies. Programmes start at 6.00am.
Corn. Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Corn singing an A-maiz-ing Counting Song.
Mine. Children's animation. Bing and Pando are tired but insist on one last game of hide-and-seek. Pando hides in Bing's bed, but by the time Bing finds him he is fast asleep.
Flamenco. Preschool series. The Teletubbies are flamenco dancing! Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po are surprisingly good.
The Box. Preschool animation. Mo is very excited by the arrival of a new lamp, but Tee is more interested in the box it came in.
Double Trouble. Supertato and Carrot are looking for ice and think Evil Pea has become kind by giving them some. They soon realise it's not Evil Pea after all.
Camping. Sula and Bing go camping to see the night sky. But then Bing sees a scary shadow...
Panic at the Pumpkin Patch. Is there really a ghost at Jackson's pumpkin patch? Mojo and Bo need to find out!
Copy the King. Follow a crazy straw, get catapulted into space in another episode of Agony and Eggstacy, and copy King Tiger as he delivers a set of his most demanding royal moves yet.
The Reunion Badge. Duggee hosts a reunion for the first ever Squirrels he looked after.
Bedroom. Bluey is excited to get her own room. But when bedtime comes, she misses her sister Bingo.
Seesaw. Dad has rudely plonked himself on one end of the seesaw. So Bluey and Bingo round up the entire playground to help flip him off, but they still need to find one more friend.
Pirate Peril, Jamaica. Xuli dives into action when Glitch's pirate game puts Lars in danger. Yo-ho Go Jetters go!
The Tale of the New Hideout. Animated series. When the rabbits are forced out of their secret treehouse, they learn that keeping their new hideout a secret will be difficult.
The Remipedes. Animated deep sea adventures with Captain Barnacles and his explorers. When Shellington gets lost in a dark sea cave, he gets assistance from some blind remipedes.
Nine. Children's animation. Numberblock Nine arrives in Numberland, finds a friend in Four, sings a song about squares - and sneezes.
Box. The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. B, O and X discover a box filled with everything they need to put on a performance.
Family of Cats. With help from some kittens, Nick and the Popcasters put on a big concert at the old town hall for two very special mums.
Rainbow. It's nice to relax indoors. The Nogglins discover some rainbow stripes, and Itty chooses a game - but not everyone wants to play.
Pockets. Bella and Lift visit Patch in the Cloud Kitchen. He has found a tiny mouse in his pocket, which reminds him of a tasty treat recipe to make with the Playtimers - pocket mouse pitta!
Fireworks. Children's animation series. Sula and Amma go round to Bing's house to watch the fireworks, and Bing thinks he is brave enough to watch the fireworks from the garden.
Bread. Dee encourages a friend to say 'bread', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure! We see flat bread, baking bread, rainbow bread and butterfly bread.
Find the Blueberries. Lu and Biba accidentally rig their treasure hunt game.
Flappy Snap. Cherry wants to photograph a rare butterfly. The Piggies try to help but get too competitive and scare it away. Now, they must team up to fix their mistake.
More About Getting Wet. Stop-motion preschool programme. The Twirlywoos watch as a man washes his clothes and gets very wet. Then Peekaboo gets wet back on the Big Red Boat.
Beach Day. Mr Tumble is getting ready for a day at the beach but has some unexpected passengers.
Picnic. Preschool series. The Teletubbies go on a special picnic together. Lots of tubby toast pops out of the Dup Dup and lands on the picnic plates for the Teletubbies to munch.
Noisy. Giovanna, Baby Bear and everyone at The Baby Club explore noisy objects and toys through discovery, play, song and story time. Grown-ups and little ones at home can join in too!
Play Centre. Elsee joins her friend Mylah for a fun game of I-spy at a play centre.

programmes.show_name: New: What's in Your Plant Pot?
programmes.show_description: Mint. Herb farmer Jekka introduces the Fact Pack to mint plants. They discover how mint grows, what makes it taste and smell so fresh, and how mint can be used in many different ways.
Dusty, Old Box. A dusty, old box makes Rebecca sneeze! Murphi dreams up some make ideas to help reveal what's inside, including a tissue box monster and a flamingo sock puppet.
Prickly Problem. Ginger and the Peas get trapped in an underwater cave with a pack of inflated Lycheemodus!
Zoo. Bluey's backyard zoo is home to wonderful animals, especially the big blue daddy gorilla. But when he grabs visitor Bingo and escapes, zookeeper Bluey must recapture the wild beast.
The Direction Badge. The Squirrels go out for a walk but can't find a way back to the clubhouse.   Followed by Hey Duggee.
Bear House and Football Walk. Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers see a house with a bear face and say hello to a bug on a walk to a place to play football.
Meet Amanpreet's Family. Amanpreet and her family visit a safari park and join in with a rhino mud bath!
Marina's Mexican Enchiladas. Marina takes us to Mexico, cooking a traditional dish called enchiladas. She also entertains her friends with a traditional mariachi band.
Clock and Cutlery. Maddie uses special cameras to find out how clocks tell the time and how cutlery is made.
Mission: Postbox. Guide dog Kika and Dr Amit have a very important letter to post. But first, they need to buy a stamp. Will they get to the postbox in time to catch the last collection?
Barn Owl and Bats. Steve and Aneeshwar feed some fruit bats and meet Wallace the barn owl.
Waffle Misses Doug. Preschool comedy drama series. Doug's mum Zoe brings surprises for the Brooklyn-Bells, but Waffle is sad because Doug is going to stay with her for a few days.
Daytime Sleepover. Oona and Baba have a daytime sleepover with the Hoots.
Feelings. Animated series about a group of singing potatoes. The Small Potatoes sing a guitar-driven rock 'n' roll anthem celebrating their feelings.
Play with Your Food. Toad needs a new pumpkin double bass. Yukee and Twinkle use vegetables from the veggie patch to create some surprising instruments - but none are quite right for Toad.
Disco Train. Maddie and Triggs take a magical journey through the sky on Granny's disco train.
The Babysitting Badge. Duggee has a job to do outside the Clubhouse, but who will look after the Squirrels? King Tiger, of course, since he has his babysitting badge!
Back in the Box! The Numberblocks have fun counting as they tidy up after playing games, but One finds it hard to keep track of everything. The friends use tally marks to fix their problem.
Treasure. Searching for treasure, the Alphablocks ride towards a BIG tree on the back of a PIG. They feed it a FIG and accidentally make it a WIG. At the tree, they DIG up something unusual.
Back in Time. Justin and his friends step back in time, and Mr Tumble has some clock trouble.
Bouncing. Preschool series. Laa-Laa and Po drive the Tubby Car to the Hidey Hup and take turns on the Tubby Bouncy. Tinky Winky and Dipsy arrive and they have a go at bouncing too.
Blackbirds. Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers go on an eco quest to find out all about blackbirds.
Chicken and Egg. Will Jaz get all her tasks done in time to be able to perform her egg dance with her dad?
Flying Machines. Series for young children that celebrates many different kinds of amazing machines. In this episode, Grace shows off three fantastic machines that all fly!
Woolly Mammoth and Ice. Preschool adventure series. Andy dons his winter coat and heads off on another prehistoric adventure, this time back 30,000 years to the last ice age.
Red Envelope Day. Love Monster tries to stop Delivery Duckling from accidentally delivering an empty envelope from him to Elder Kitten on Red Envelope Day.
Caterpillar Caravan. The Octonauts search for a new habitat for some sleeping caterpillars.
The Tale of the Brewing Storm. Animated series. Peter, Lily and Benjamin race to rescue Cotton-tail's beloved blanket, escape Mr Tod and get back home before a brewing storm breaks.
The Senses Badge. Roly has lost his best potato, but Duggee finds it using his sense of smell.
Juno Mama Day. Juno can't wait for Juno Mama Day, but when Mama Hippo gets a cold, it's a very different day than Juno expected. Luckily, she learns that she's a great junior nurse!
Frantic Football. Evil Pea challenges the Tato Team to a football match but cheats with her 'cheaty boots'.
Mission Sleep. The ducklings are exhausted and just want to sleep, but Weasy starts snoring.
UFO. Mojo and Bo only wanted to help fix a satellite dish with Mojo's chopper top. Now they've been mistaken for a UFO, and the whole town is in a tizzy about invading aliens!
Bedroom. Bluey is excited to get her own room. But when bedtime comes, she misses her sister Bingo.
The Mystery Gossiper. A mystery gossiper causes friction on the berg, until Brinicle sets a clever trap.
Seesaw. Dad has rudely plonked himself on one end of the seesaw. So Bluey and Bingo round up the entire playground to help flip him off, but they still need to find one more friend.
Andy, the T Rex and the Volcano. Andy and Jen embark on an adventure across Dino Island to investigate a mysterious sound.
Goodbye Waffle? Preschool comedy drama series. It's time to say goodbye to the puppy. Evie goes with Jess to her veterinary practice to scan Waffle's microchip.
The Bubble Wish. Rafi's bubble wish fills the park with magical fun.
It's Time to Fly a Kite. JoJo and Gran Gran take Gran Gran's old kite out to the park to fly on a windy day.
Brolly Bus. Animation for preschool children. When Umbrella gets left on the bus, Sarah and Duck head to the bus depot in search of their friend.
Chicken in Charge. Animation about a family of small creatures who live on, and inside, a planet. Major, Mother and Granny go on a trip, leaving the Iron Chicken in charge.
Happy Happy. MeMo and BaBa realise that spreading a little happiness can make them happy too. It's okay not to feel happy, and just being there for a friend can help.
Makka Pakka's Present. Makka Pakka makes a pile of six stones. He gives everyone in the garden a stone for a present and is left with one, a special stone for Makka Pakka.
Chris and Rosie Ramsey - When Jelly Had a Wobble. Chris and Rosie Ramsey read When Jelly Had a Wobble.
